title: A mistaken duplicate cannot be reopened, a bug can relate to itself, and link refusals name no recovery
symptom: chough bug update <id> --status open on a duplicate bug fails with 'duplicate_of is only set for duplicate bugs'; --related <its own id> is accepted; the self-duplicate and unknown-bug refusals name no command to recover with
trigger: mark a bug duplicate by mistake and try to reopen it; link a bug to itself with --related; name an unknown bug
expected: reopening clears duplicate_of and notes it; a self-related link is refused; each refusal names chough bug list --all (and verified without a linked failure names chough bug update <id> --observation <id>)
actual: the reopen is refused, the self link is recorded, and the refusals say only what is wrong
steps: chough bug update <id> --duplicate-of <other>, then chough bug update <id> --status open
impact: a bug marked duplicate by mistake stays a duplicate for good; a bug's related list can name itself; an agent refused here is not told how to recover
source: #153, found writing the audit Bugs row's tests

notes.text: BUG-0019 (verified) made validation errors name their fix; these link refusals were not covered
status: open -> verified. Fixed in 4edae055: both failing-first cases pass after the fix
